selection_policy: The journal champion is selected without 2022. The frozen 2022 sample is confirmatory and cannot change model weights, architecture, losses, or the sampled dates.
primary_endpoint: Paired difference in mean normalized RMSE over all 24 fields and all interior query hours, separately at 6 h and 12 h.
primary_inference: Two-sided paired seven-day block bootstrap with 95% confidence intervals; the candidate must have an upper confidence bound below zero against WeatherDCAE-14M.
secondary_endpoints: scalar and vector spherical-harmonic energy, shape, coherence, and signed cospectrum
failure_policy: If either primary horizon fails, the manuscript must report the limitation and may not claim universal post-selection dominance.
